definition: A technique for understanding what a neural network unit has learned by generating or finding inputs that maximally activate it.
details: Feature visualization is a classic interpretability technique from computer vision, producing images that reveal the visual patterns a given neuron or channel has come to detect.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Feature Visualization.
